deployment.provenance: Deployment ID and commit supplied by parent after its Cloudflare API verification.

scope: Public Git-integrated production HTTP only. No GitHub video requests, authentication, uploads, source edits, or full media downloads. Audio responses are closed after 64 bytes, whether HTTP 200 or 206.

criteria.audio: HTTP 200 or 206, audio MIME, and first 64 bytes equal the local source. Range support is reported separately.
criteria.images: HEAD 200 and image MIME. Content-Length must match local bytes when present; absence means unknown, not a load failure.
criteria.privatePaths: HTTP 404 with no source-code markers in a bounded response sample.
